item.description: KNOCKDOWN Structure Fire; INC#0433; 07:24AM; 7032 N Baird Av; MAP: <a href="https://bit.ly/4hGAldW" target="_blank" rel="noopener">https://bit.ly/4hGAldW</a>; Reseda; 34 firefighters knocked down the fire in 16 minutes. Due to this structure being the site of a previous burn, LAFD firefighters remained in a defensive posture out of precaution. LADBS (Los Angeles Dept. of Building and Safety) haver been notified due to the extensive damage and safety risks present at the property. No injuries are reported. Cause of fire is undetermined. Cliff Rescue, San Pedro; INC#0252; 03:50AM; 1 Point Fermin; MAP: <a href="https://bit.ly/3nw6hUE" target="_blank" rel="noopener">https://bit.ly/3nw6hUE</a>; San Pedro; First arriving unit reports an adult male fell approximately 30 feet from the cliff at Point Fermin in the "Sunken City" area. LAFD Air Ops is conducting a hoist operation to rescue and transport the patient in critical condition to a local trauma center. All questions regarding circumstances are referred to LAPD Harbor Division, Inc#0682. Structure Fire; INC#0560; 08:59AM; 7034 N Baird Av; MAP: <a href="https://bit.ly/4yAEGFm" target="_blank" rel="noopener">https://bit.ly/4yAEGFm</a>; Reseda; First arriving fire companies report a single story detached garage fully involved with fire. Firefighters are operating in an offensive mode. During the operations, fire companies are reporting explosions on the property, possibly propane tanks exposed to the fire. One single family structure is exposed and is also burning. No injuries reported and no patients or victims are reported at this time. Cause of the fire is undetermined at this time. Department of Transportation has been requested for traffic control and LAPD requested, LAPD incident 1420. IC has requested additional fire companies to assist in the fire suppression operations.; FS 73; Batt 17; Valley Bureau; Council District 4; BC15 BC17 E100 E103 E104 E273 E293 EM15 RA100 RA898 T73 T93; CH9; 18; Jamie Stewart

Building was a 100 foot by 200 foot 1 story commercial with a two story portion attached to the building. Extinguishment of the fire in approximately 100 minutes from the time of the 911 call. No injuries at this time. Arson has been requested, as well as heavy equipment to help with overhaul operations.
